headlines.description: — Logan Thompson stopped 24 shots, and the Washington Capitals kept their slim playoff hopes alive by beating the Pittsburgh Penguins 3-0 Sunday in perhaps the final home of Alex Ovechkin's brilliant career.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ovechkin, Capitals keep postseason hopes alive with 3-0 victory over Penguins

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Nick Suzuki had a goal and an assist to pass the 100-point mark for the season and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Islanders 4-1 on Sunday, eliminating New York from playoff contention.
headlines.shortLinkText: Suzuki reaches 100-point mark, Canadiens eliminate Islanders from playoff contention

events.name: Boston Bruins at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Mark Kastelic scored with 9:38 remaining and the Boston Bruins snapped a five-game losing streak with a 3-2 win over Columbus 3-2 on Sunday that moved them into the first Eastern Conference wild-card spot while virtually eliminating the Blue Jackets...
headlines.shortLinkText: Kastelic scores in 3rd period to lift Bruins over Blue Jackets 3-2, into first wild-card spot

events.name: Ottawa Senators at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Nico Hischier scored his second goal of the game on the power play with 1:45 left in overtime to give the New Jersey Devils a 4-3 win over the Ottawa Senators on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nico Hischier scores in overtime, Devils beat the Senators 4-3

headlines.description: — Marco Rossi scored with 9.5 seconds left in overtime to help the Vancouver Canucks beat Anaheim 4-3 on Sunday night and prevent the Ducks from clinching a playoff spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rossi scores with 9.5 seconds left in regulation, Canucks beat Ducks 4-3

headlines.description: — Brayden Pachal scored his first NHL goal of the season and added two assists on Sunday night as the Calgary Flames’ hot streak at home continued with a 4-1 victory over the Utah Mammoth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brayden Pachal has 3 points as the Flames beat the Mammoth 4-1
